message: Surya, Lena and Farah, sunny balance closes but cloudy stays open. Plain words, one day feeds holding plus capped batch with margin, half a household day. Numbers are 5.60 kWh per day need from daily batch electric for 200 kg (E55) against 8.10 kWh per day from daily PV yield from 2.4 kWp (E54) and 2.10 kWh night use from night energy at 150 W (E57), where Photovoltaic (PV) means solar panels. Surya, please compute sunless days.
